mechanism: Place one visibly mis-scaled subject inside a familiar step-by-step procedure and require sincere compliance. Let each successive checkpoint expose a different physical fit failure while the subject preserves dignity. Use imaging to reveal a nested counterpart inside one bound container, then physically expose the same counterpart and hold both scales plus the main subject's reaction so the physical reveal independently confirms the scan.

invariants.rule: Use a procedure with immediately recognizable ordered checkpoints.
invariants.purpose: Lets the audience predict normal behavior.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unfamiliar process cannot create clear mismatch.

invariants.rule: Keep the subject sincere and restrained throughout compliance.
invariants.ablation_failure: Deliberate clowning weakens the procedural contrast.

invariants.rule: Escalate through different fit failures rather than repeated alarms.
invariants.purpose: Adds new evidence at each step.

invariants.rule: Reveal the nested counterpart first through an imaging device while it remains inside the same bound container.
invariants.purpose: Creates the first inspectable proof before physical confirmation.
invariants.ablation_failure: Immediate emergence removes the scan-to-physical double-proof structure.

invariants.rule: Physically expose the same counterpart and hold a visible reaction with both scales present.
invariants.purpose: Independently confirms the scan without inventing a function or explanation.
invariants.ablation_failure: A screen-only ending can still be read as a scan error; an off-screen reveal cannot prove identity continuity.

instantiations.concept: An oversized clockwork parade elephant follows a museum intake, submits a tiny tool chest, fails measuring fixtures, then x-ray reveals six folded paper moths that physically emerge from the same chest and hover beside the elephant.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Deadpan conservation procedure with increasing fit failures and scan-to-physical nested confirmation.

instantiations.concept: A giant soft-plastic delivery mascot enters a passport-photo booth; thermal imaging reveals three miniature badge mascots inside its hollow badge, then the same badge opens and the three figures step out while both scales hold in frame.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Photo-booth scale mismatch ending in imaging and physical double proof.

instantiations.concept: An enormous origami crane enters an automated parcel return; transmitted light reveals three tiny folded cranes inside one wing sleeve, then the sleeve opens and the same three cranes emerge beside it.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Parcel procedure mismatch with transmitted-image proof and matching physical reveal.
